notes:
Summary: LightHarbor builds a hosted KB product for mid-market SaaS customers. Main asks: fast recall + precise reranking to reduce agent escalation. Primary metrics: 95th-pct rerank latency <= 120ms, end-to-end retrieval+rerank <= 200ms for single-turn queries; cost target < $0.003/query at peak after batching/caching. Index scale: moderate (~100k-300k passages); QPS profile: high (baseline 300-500 qps, peak 800-1,200 qps for small tenants during business hours).

Technical details / preferences:
- Pipeline: nightly full reindex + near-real-time deltas (webhook-driven).
- Embedding model: prefer open-weights or Redwood-curated embeddings with 1536-d vectors; will test 1024 vs 1536 for cost/accuracy tradeoff.
- Reranker: cross-encoder for top-10 rerank; candidate generation via ANN (HNSW).
- Retrieval+rerank flow: bi-encoder ANN -> top-100 -> cross-encoder rerank top-10 -> final answer. Want to explore reducing candidate set and using cache for hot queries.
- Operational: multi-tenant isolation, per-tenant cost reporting, token-level cost breakdown in console.

POC scope & success criteria:
- Ingest ~150k docs, produce stable embeddings, validate freshness for streaming deltas.
- Rerank P95 latency <= 120ms on hosted API with 1k concurrent QPS load (ramp test).
- Cost per successful query (retrieval+rerank) target < $0.003 post-optimization.
- Quality: MRR improvement vs current TF-IDF baseline by +18% on labeled eval set (50 queries).

Direct quotes & call notes:
- "If 95th >120ms, we can't sign — our customers expect near-instant replies." — Head of Platform (2025-01-09).
- AE notes: interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations (quantization, batching) to hit cost target.

Security & compliance:
- Require SOC2; EU data residency for several customer accounts. SSO/SAML mandatory for admin console. Audit logs retention 1 year. KMS integration requested for future Dedicated/Private evaluation.

Risks & open items:
- Initial hosted API run showed 95th latency ~220ms at 600 qps with cross-encoder rerank (unoptimized). Need kernel-level optimizations, batching, and smaller candidate sizes.
- Price sensitivity: Finance expects ARR math to work for $40k-$120k ARR bracket; per-query economics critical.
- Legal wants explicit SLA appendix for Dedicated migration path.

Next actions (short):
- Run 72h high-QPS rerank benchmark on hosted API (SE + Lightharbor infra team). Collect detailed token and latency traces. (Owner: Marco Ruiz).
- Share perf/cost CSV and suggested Optimize config (quantization level, batch sizes) by 2025-02-18.
- Follow up on SOC2 artifacts and EU residency proof; security call scheduled 2025-02-14.
